knowledge02_summarize.followUpReply: The harbour renovation budget was **4.2 million dollars**, and it was approved by the council in **March 2026** (coastal-report.pdf, p. 22–24).
knowledge02_summarize.summaryReply:
Here is a summary of the report:

*   **Overall Status:** Most indicators across all reviewed sectors (Coastal Erosion, Lighthouse Operations, Fisheries, Visitor Services, Storm Preparedness, Habitat Restoration, Water Quality, and Harbour Maintenance) remained within normal ranges, with observed seasonal variation (coastal-report.pdf, p. 1-8; coastal-report.pdf, p. 24-32).
*   **Monitoring & Inspections:** Teams completed scheduled inspections, logged findings, and filed follow-up requests for repairs or further study in all districts (coastal-report.pdf, p. 1-8; coastal-report.pdf, p. 24-32)
